title: Sell Mineral Rights in Eldridge, AL
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Eldridge, AL | Offer
metaDescription: Eldridge, Walker County mineral owner in the Black Warrior CBM belt? We buy interests with a fair cash offer based on real production data.
heroLead: Eldridge sits in western Walker County, deep in coal country, where the land underneath has been mined, leased, and re-leased for well over a hundred years before coalbed methane operators ever arrived.
intro: Walker County was one of the original centers of Alabama coal production, and Eldridge's mineral records reflect that history directly. Many families here hold interests that were first reserved when a coal company bought surface rights generations ago, long before anyone thought to drill the same coal seams for the gas trapped inside them.

sections.heading: Coal-era reservations and modern gas rights
paragraphs: Because Eldridge's mineral history runs through the coal industry first, some deeds here use older language that was written with mining, not gas production, in mind. In most cases, courts and operators have treated broad mineral reservations as covering natural gas as well as coal, but the specific wording still matters when we confirm exactly what you own.
We review this history as part of every Eldridge evaluation, since it affects how confidently we can quote a number.

sections.heading: What the Walker County Probate Office can tell you
paragraphs: If your family's Eldridge interest passed down without a will, the Walker County Probate Office in Jasper is usually where the relevant estate records sit. We can pull these records directly in most cases, saving you a trip to the courthouse, and use them to confirm your legal right to sell.
Owners who have never dealt with probate before often find this step less intimidating than expected, especially for smaller estates.

faqs.question: My deed only mentions coal. Does that cover the gas rights too?
faqs.answer: Often yes, if the reservation is broadly worded, but we check the specific language on your deed before assuming it extends to coalbed methane production.

faqs.question: Where would my family's probate records be filed?
faqs.answer: For Eldridge and the rest of Walker County, that is typically the Walker County Probate Office in Jasper.

faqs.question: Is coalbed methane still being actively produced near Eldridge?
faqs.answer: Much of the production in this part of the basin is mature, meaning steady but declining output from wells drilled years ago rather than fresh drilling.

faqs.question: How do I find out if I am even listed as an owner?
faqs.answer: Send us your family's deed or any old lease paperwork and we can research current ownership and production records on your behalf.

faqs.question: What operator handles most Eldridge-area wells today?
faqs.answer: Diversified Energy operates a large share of the legacy Black Warrior Basin coalbed methane wells across Walker County, including much of the acreage near Eldridge.
